@@ -52,12 +52,160 @@ csql -u dba -c "insert into t values(1);" $db_name;
 
 cubrid unloaddb  $db_name
 
+# Keep the valid input for a second load after the failed batch.
+cp $ofile test2_valid.objects
+if grep -Eq '^%class[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]*t__p__p0\]?[[:space:]]' $ofile
+then
+    write_ok "test2: generated input targets the child partition"
+else
+    write_nok "test2: expected child partition input was not generated"
+fi
 #add 100 to objects file
 echo 100 >> $ofile
 recreate_db
 
-echo "========== test2 ==========" >> $res
-cubrid loaddb -C -v -u dba -s $sfile -d $ofile $db_name >> $res 2>&1 
+# This load must reject 100: p0 only accepts i < 10. Keep its output
+# separate from the successful-load answers used by test1 and test3.
+cubrid loaddb -C -v -c 100 -u dba -s $sfile -d $ofile $db_name > test2_invalid.output 2>&1
+load_status=$?
+cat test2_invalid.output
+if [ "$load_status" -ne 0 ]
+then
+    write_ok "test2: invalid partition load failed"
+else
+    write_nok "test2: invalid partition load unexpectedly succeeded"
+fi
+if grep -q "Appropriate partition does not exist" test2_invalid.output
+then
+    write_ok "test2: partition error reported"
+else
+    write_nok "test2: missing partition error"
+fi
+
+if grep -q "Total 0 object(s) inserted, 1 object(s) failed." test2_invalid.output
+then
+    write_ok "test2: failed batch reports zero inserted and one failed object"
+else
+    write_nok "test2: failed batch object counts mismatch"
+fi
+
+# Both rows are below the explicit 100-row commit interval and must be
+# rolled back. Check the root and the physical partition independently.
+for tbl in t t__p__p0
+do
+    if csql -u dba -t -N -c "select count(*) from $tbl;" $db_name > test2_rollback_$tbl.output 2>&1 &&
+        [ "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < test2_rollback_$tbl.output)" = "0" ]
+    then
+        write_ok "test2: $tbl failed batch rolled back"
+    else
+        write_nok "test2: $tbl failed batch was not empty or query failed"
+        cat test2_rollback_$tbl.output
+    fi
+done
+
+# The same database must remain usable, and the original valid input
+# must load exactly one row (i = 1) after the failed attempt.
+if cubrid loaddb -C -v -u dba -d test2_valid.objects $db_name > test2_valid.output 2>&1 &&
+    grep -q "Total 1 object(s) inserted, 0 object(s) failed." test2_valid.output
+then
+    write_ok "test2: next valid load succeeded"
+else
+    write_nok "test2: next valid load failed"
+    cat test2_valid.output
+fi
+for tbl in t t__p__p0
+do
+    if csql -u dba -t -N -c "select case when count(*) = 1 and min(i) = 1 and max(i) = 1 then 1 else 0 end from $tbl;" $db_name > test2_valid_$tbl.output 2>&1 &&
+        [ "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < test2_valid_$tbl.output)" = "1" ]
+    then
+        write_ok "test2: $tbl contains exactly the next valid row"
+    else
+        write_nok "test2: $tbl next valid row mismatch or query failed"
+        cat test2_valid_$tbl.output
+    fi
+done
+rm -f test2_valid.objects
+
+# Root input must route to the correct child; direct-child input must
+# validate that child's domain even if another child would accept the row.
+function check_partition_rows {
+    local tbl=$1 count=$2 minimum=$3 maximum=$4
+    if csql -C -u dba -t -N -c "select case when count(*) = $count and min(i) = $minimum and max(i) = $maximum then 1 else 0 end from $tbl;" $db_name > route_$tbl.output 2>&1 &&
+        [ "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < route_$tbl.output)" = "1" ]
+    then
+        write_ok "test2: $tbl has the expected committed rows"
+    else
+        write_nok "test2: $tbl committed rows mismatch or query failed"
+        cat route_$tbl.output
+    fi
+}
+
+function check_partition_load {
+    local objects=$1 inserted=$2 failed=$3 diagnostic=$4
+    cubrid loaddb -C -v -c 100 -u dba -d "$objects" $db_name > route_load.output 2>&1
+    local status=$?
+    local verdict_ok=0
+    if [ "$failed" -eq 0 ] && [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    then
+        verdict_ok=1
+    elif [ "$failed" -eq 1 ] && [ "$status" -ne 0 ] && grep -q "$diagnostic" route_load.output
+    then
+        verdict_ok=1
+    fi
+    if grep -q "Total $inserted object(s) inserted, $failed object(s) failed." route_load.output &&
+        [ "$verdict_ok" -eq 1 ]
+    then
+        write_ok "test2: $objects has the expected load verdict and counts"
+    else
+        write_nok "test2: $objects load verdict, diagnostic or counts mismatch"
+        cat route_load.output
+    fi
+}
+
+csql -C -u dba -c "create table t_route(i int) partition by range(i) (partition p0 values less than(10), partition p1 values less than(20));" $db_name
+cat > route_root.objects <<'EOF'
+%class dba.t_route (i)
+1
+11
+EOF
+cat > route_child.objects <<'EOF'
+%class dba.t_route__p__p0 (i)
+2
+EOF
+cat > route_child_invalid.objects <<'EOF'
+%class dba.t_route__p__p0 (i)
+3
+11
+EOF
+cat > route_root_invalid.objects <<'EOF'
+%class dba.t_route (i)
+4
+100
+EOF
+cat > route_recovery.objects <<'EOF'
+%class dba.t_route (i)
+12
+EOF
+check_partition_load route_root.objects 2 0 ""
+check_partition_load route_child.objects 1 0 ""
+for phase in before_failure after_child_failure after_root_failure
+do
+    if [ "$phase" = after_child_failure ]
+    then
+        check_partition_load route_child_invalid.objects 0 1 "Invalid value for partition definition"
+    elif [ "$phase" = after_root_failure ]
+    then
+        check_partition_load route_root_invalid.objects 0 1 "Appropriate partition does not exist"
+    fi
+    check_partition_rows t_route 3 1 11
+    check_partition_rows t_route__p__p0 2 1 2
+    check_partition_rows t_route__p__p1 1 11 11
+done
+check_partition_load route_recovery.objects 1 0 ""
+check_partition_rows t_route 4 1 12
+check_partition_rows t_route__p__p0 2 1 2
+check_partition_rows t_route__p__p1 2 11 12
+rm -f route_*.objects route_*.output
 
 #test3 large table with periodic commits
 recreate_db
